verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical and both are broken. The brush-stroke swatch has come away from the title and floats empty above it, the 'Spa Utopia' headline runs over the glass bowl, the bottom third of the canvas is dead pink space, and most of the original's product imagery (bottles, capsules) is cropped out. A also has a tighter left margin (about 18px) and a wider gap between headline and tagline. B's slightly larger margin and tighter headline-to-tagline grouping make it marginally less bad.
